## What is the function of the stapes?

The stapes is a bony ossicle (little bone) in the middle ear cavity. It transmits sound vibrations from the tympanic membrane (eardrum) to the oval window of the cochlea.

## What is the function of the malleus?

The malleus connects the eardrum to the incus, and transfers the vibrations of the eardrum to the incus. The incus connects the malleus to the stapes, and amplifies the vibrations of the malleus. The stapes pushes and pulls on the fluids in the cochlea, which stimulates the auditory nerve.

Tropical cyclones are caused by atmospheric instability, which is the result of warm ocean water interacting with the atmosphere. Warm oceans evaporate water into the atmosphere, which condenses into clouds and thunderstorms.
